name: Newspaper front page
oneLiner: a folded broadsheet is tossed onto a walnut table under a warm lamp with its masthead and a huge serif headline above the fold, then it is opened, the lower half swinging down from behind to reveal a halftone photo of the brand person and two more stories, and the camera drifts slowly down the columns
say: when the speaker says something is big news or makes the headline ('this was front page news', 'imagine the headline', 'everyone was talking about it'): cut in on the claim, the page opens as they land it
